title: A sublattice dimensionality index: code and computed results
description: Code and computed results behind 'A sublattice dimensionality index validated against deposited metal halides'. Contains the reference implementation of the index, the database-scale indexer, every script that produced a number in the paper, and the computed indices for 703 metal halides and 158 metal chalcogenides carrying author-stated dimensionality labels, together with the stoichiometric baseline, the whole-network comparison and the throughput measurements. Structures are identified by Crystallography Open Database entry number rather than redistributed.
